<b>Squatcraw Jurors</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are stout, elder [[Craws|crawbugs]] who eagerly serve the [[Craws#Court_of_Craws|Court of Craws]].<ref>Squatcraw Juror [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Short elder crawbug eagerly serving in their court."</i></ref> They are the [[Act 3]] counterparts to [[Squatcraw]]s, with slightly more health, a slightly higher damage modifier, and an immunity to needle-bounce attacks.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Squatcraw Jurors frequently switch between flying and being grounded at any time, and have no behavioural differences to their Act 1/2 counterparts.

Squatcraws Jurors' only attack is to launch three pins in an 80° fan formation, similar to the [[Threefold Pin]]. Whilst flying, they change the angle of throwing but still can cover an 80-degree area. Dodging between the pins is often necessary, so it is important to get used to the angles. Despite their stature, they are highly mobile and attempt to always fly out of Hornet's reach. They remain stationary when preparing to attack, so this is a good moment to get close and strike.

Due to their special metallic headwear, Squatcraw Jurors are completely immune to Needle-bounce attacks.

Whilst flying, remaining directly below them can allow Hornet to easily strike them with the Needle, as well as always dodge their Pins, since they can't attack directly beneath themselves whilst airborne.

Whilst they're grounded, always be ready to do a small jump to avoid the lowest Pin that they throw and capitalise on the opening.

== Location ==
Squatcraw Jurors can be found exclusively in [[Greymoor]] during the [[Court of Craws]] fight in the [[Craw Lake]] building.
